metaTitle: Custom Acrylic Distance Barriers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom acrylic distance barriers for your business. Perfect Imprints offers clear, durable barriers with your logo. Contact us today!
introHtml: Acrylic distance barriers provide a clear, professional way to maintain separation in reception areas, checkout counters, and office workspaces. Unlike opaque dividers, acrylic keeps sightlines open while offering durable protection. Custom imprint your logo or safety messaging directly on the barrier for a cohesive branded safety solution. Ideal for retail, healthcare, and corporate environments where visibility and hygiene are priorities.
heroAltText: Custom acrylic distance barriers with clear panels and printed logos for office and retail use
